info.title: Aura Admin API
info.description: TCP + bearer-token surface: config, jobs, cron, memory, traces, skills, tools, channels, LLM.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session id whose trace to export

200.description: Raw trace tree for the session. Shape mirrors `aura_trace::TraceNode` but is emitted as untyped JSON to keep the admin surface decoupled from internal trace crate changes.

ApprovedResource.description:
Mirror of [`aura_model::ApprovedResource`]. Paths serialize as
strings on the wire.

ChannelType.description:
Admin-surface mirror of [`aura_model::ChannelType`]. Matches the
`snake_case` wire format exactly; conversions below round-trip.

CreateCronRequest.description:
`POST /v1/cron` body. Schedule format is the standard 5-field cron
string accepted by [`aura_cron`].

ErrorBody.description:
Uniform error envelope for every non-2xx admin response.

`GatewayError::into_response` already emits `{"error": "..."}`; this
type just pins the shape in the spec so clients can discriminate on
it rather than on status codes alone.

value.description: JSON value written at `path`. Shape validated by `AuraConfig`.
